name: Psychostatic Veil
text: The bearer gains Lone Operative and a 4+ invulnerable save, and every melee attack that targets the bearer takes -1 to its hit roll.

effect.name: Psychostatic Veil
effect.text: 4+ invulnerable save, Lone Operative, and -1 to hit for melee attacks that target the bearer.

name: Secretion Goad
text: Once per turn, when a friendly TYRANIDS unit with a model within 6 inches of the bearer (the bearer's own unit included) is selected to shoot or to fight, you may improve the AP of that unit's weapons by 1 until the end of the phase. Works in either player's turn.

effect.name: Secretion Goad
effect.text: Once per turn, improve the AP of a nearby friendly TYRANIDS unit's weapons by 1 for the phase when it is selected to shoot or fight.

name: Neurogoad
text: In your Command phase, pick one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 12 inches of the bearer (the bearer's own unit allowed). Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit may re-roll its Charge rolls and its models may re-roll their hit rolls.

effect.name: Neurogoad
effect.text: Once per Command phase, a nearby friendly TYRANIDS unit may re-roll Charge rolls and hit rolls until your next Command phase.

name: Psionic Phantoms
text: Once per battle round, when the bearer is chosen as a target of ranged attacks by an enemy unit, it may make a Normal move of up to 6 inches. If that unit can then no longer see the bearer, roll a D6: on 1-3 the models that had picked the bearer may choose new targets; on 4-6 they cannot, and make no attacks this phase.

effect.name: Psionic Phantoms
effect.text: When targeted by ranged attacks, once per battle round, the bearer may slip 6 inches away and possibly spoil the shots.
